scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there, I recently applied for a housing loan and I'm just checking in on the status of my application. Could you please tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what type of loan product was I approved for, if it was approved?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The loan product type is a Conventional:Subordinate Lien.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for letting me know. What is the interest rate for this loan? And could you also tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate for your loan is 9.5%. The loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: I see. What are the total costs of this loan? And has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include the total costs of the loan. The loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Understood. What is my debt-to-income ratio, and how does that affect my application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 36%. This ratio represents the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying debts. The record does not include underwriting rationale, so I cannot explain how this ratio specifically affected your application.

dialogue.user:
I see. Thank you for the information. That's all I needed to know.

<Neutral> - I got the answers to my questions, but I was hoping for a bit more detail on some of the points, like the total costs of the loan.
